big_play_def: TD/FG/TURNOVER/SAFETY/BIG_PLAY with |Δp_home| >= 0.08 (pre=last trade [-60,-5]s, post=VWAP [+30,+90]s) and halfway-cross within [-10,+90]s of ESPN wallclock
move_start_def: first trade after the last trade (from w-20s up to t_half) still within max(2c, 20% of Δ) of the pre price

push_rules.note: Phone-buzz simulation. at_detection_M = provisional push only if the move at detection >= M (live rule, PROVISIONAL_PUSH_MIN=M; today M=0.10). late_M = hypothetical patch: push at the first quote within CALL_DELAY (8 s) where the move reaches M. If no stage-1 push, first buzz is assumed to be the stage-2 'called' push at detection+8 s (best case; live only pushes it if the play is named or |delta|>=0.12). Push delivery +1 s assumed. precision_pushed = share of pushed alerts within [-20,+90] s of a TD/FG/TURNOVER/SAFETY/20+yd play; _incl_swing also counts ESPN WP moves >= 5 pts.

fidelity: pipeline/latency_study.py live_detect() replays engine/live.py Engine._detect; on 12 games x the 1.75 s poll stream the real _detect (imported from engine.live) and the port fired 135/135 alerts at identical timestamps.

current_config.feed: REST order-book poll, ~1.2-3 s per game (WS off: no prod key, per /api/health 14:55)

latency_budget_current_s.ref: median seconds, big plays (n=243 in 73 games); detection deltas from the replayed configs
latency_budget_current_s.derivation: crossing = ws_t0.08_h0_w20 (2.59) - 0.2 ws latency; hold = ws_t0.08_h3_w20 (5.53) - ws_t0.08_h0_w20 (2.59); poll = current_poll1.75 (6.89) - ws_t0.08_h3_w20 (5.53); gate = median first buzz (8.19) - (detection 6.89 + push 1.0); the gate costs +8 s on the ~half of alerts whose move at detection is < 0.10 (p75 first buzz 14.5 s).

with_ws_max_recall.push_note: keep PROVISIONAL_PUSH_MIN=0.10: first buzz 5.40 s, 5.86 pushes/game at 0.491/0.839 (phone precision -5 pts); 0.09 pushes every alert: 4.38 s but 9.6 pushes/game at 0.454/0.808

per_play.note: fire_ms = first alert (stage 1, before push delivery) with matching sign in [t_move_start-5s, ESPN+90s]; null = missed
